description: Archive a published announcement so it is no longer returned by the public endpoint. Archiving requires the announcement.publish permission and an approved request; the approval is checked again when the action executes. Requires a service JWT obtained from the caller PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method.

approvalId.description: Id of the approved request that authorizes this archival.

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.description: Archiving requires an approval request from another administrator.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The approval id is invalid or does not match this announcement.

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.description: Only published announcements can be archived.
